Alex was the reason I came to Berkeley in the first place, and his kindness and support as a teacher provided the ideal environment for me to develop as a student and a teacher.

relations.subject: Daniel M. Stuart
relations.evidence: Padmanabh S. Jaini took me under his wing in my early years at Berkeley and, while encouraging me to work broadly on all forms of Indic literature, made sure that I did not forget the relevance of the Abhidharma Sastras.

relations.subject: Daniel M. Stuart
relations.evidence: I am also especially indebted to the tutelage of Rupert Gethin, whose insights into the meditative traditions of Theravada Buddhism have had a lasting impact on how I think about the Buddhist tradition as a whole.

relations.subject: Daniel M. Stuart
relations.evidence: Robert Sharf provided me the opportunity to explore the great breadth of the Buddhist traditions of China, traditions which are not directly relevant to the present project but which gave me new perspectives on the Indian material.
